Change c0400. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. IV; 1831 Ch. XXI.

Context before (unchanged): I gasped for breath; and, throwing myself on the body, I exclaimed, "Have my murderous machinations deprived you also, my dearest Henry, of life?

1818 text: Two I have already destroyed; other victims await their destiny: but you, Clerval, my friend, my benefactor"— The human frame could no longer support the agonizing suffering that I endured, and I was carried out of the room in strong convulsions.
